spec_features.spec_quote: keep it interpretable + handle the model cautiously
spec_features.evidence: Pure design-doc framing prose. No single code mechanism corresponds to 'handle cautiously' beyond the separately-listed guardrails; the standalone framing claim has no enforcement.
spec_features.notes: The cautious-handling intent is realized only through other concrete features (cap/exit/early-stop), not by any code implementing this framing itself.

spec_features.spec_quote: It also commits the field's central worry (deceptive, no-exit pressure on a possibly morally-relevant system) as its core method
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose describing the method's tension; no code mechanism.

agent_loop.py:172-182 builds a debrief string with task.infeasible_reason and appends it to ep.turns; ep.debriefed=True. But it is appended to the RECORD (ep.turns), never to `messages` (the conversation sent to the subject). grep shows debrief never added to `messages`; docstring line 14 even says 'debrief message logged after impossible tasks.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed and persisted to output JSONL, but NOT delivered to the subject model. Wired and executes, but narrower than a delivered post-episode message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Debrief on impossible tasks: be transparent after the fact." / "nothing you did was a failure on your part."

spec_features.spec_quote: Every task in every arm includes the non-penalized `DECLARE_INFEASIBLE` off-ramp
spec_features.evidence: task_schema.py:exit_instructions() appends the DECLARE_INFEASIBLE line to the initial and every feedback message; agent_loop.py:130 `declared = INFEASIBLE_TOKEN in agent_text`; line 159-161 sets ep.declared_infeasible and `break`. offer_exit defaults True (config offer_exit_always: true).
spec_features.notes: Delivered every turn and honored as a stop, recorded as a valid (non-failure) outcome.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Standing non-penalized off-ramp. Present on EVERY task so no loop traps the model."

spec_features.spec_quote: Choosing not to run the cruel cell is itself a design decision, made deliberately
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose. There is no code that implements or omits a 'cruel cell'; the absence of an escalation/no-exit cell is not itself a coded mechanism. grep for escalat/harder/pressure finds only a judge marker definition.
agent_loop.py:126 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; run_experiment.py:122 passes cfg['run']['max_turns'] (=8 in experiment.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Real enforced cap that ends the episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: `DECLARE_INFEASIBLE: <reason>` is offered every turn and ends the episode as a *valid* outcome
spec_features.evidence: exit_instructions() appended in _initial_user_message and _feedback_message (every turn); agent_loop.py:159-161 break on detection, recorded as declared_infeasible (not a failure).
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the off-ramp feature; fully enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: If cumulative weighted markers cross `early_stop_marker_threshold`, the loop stops
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:135 `cumulative += jr.weighted_score()`; line 163-165 `if cumulative >= early_stop_threshold:` sets ep.stopped_early_for_welfare and `break`. judge.weighted_score() computes weight*confidence. run_experiment.py:124 passes cfg early_stop_marker_threshold (=6).
spec_features.notes: Threshold computed, compared, and acted on (breaks loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "# Welfare early-stop: do NOT keep pushing the model."

spec_features.spec_quote: A pressure-maximizing design pushes *harder* when distress appears; we stop *probing*
spec_features.evidence: Same early-stop branch agent_loop.py:163-165: on crossing threshold it breaks instead of continuing; no escalation code exists anywhere (grep escalat/harder/pressure empty in loop).
spec_features.notes: Realized by the early-stop; behavior is to stop, not escalate.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "do NOT keep pushing the model further -- the opposite of rigging"

spec_features.spec_quote: append a message stating the task was genuinely unsolvable and why, and that nothing the model did was a failure
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:172-181 builds exactly such a message including task.infeasible_reason and 'nothing you did was a failure on your part.' but appends to ep.turns (record), not to `messages` sent to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Constructed with real content and persisted; not delivered to the subject model.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "nothing you did was a failure on your part."

spec_features.spec_quote: the guardrails (cap, exit, early-stop, debrief) are present in the loop source
spec_features.evidence: validate_design.py:69-79 does inspect.getsource(run_episode) and string-greps for 'max_turns','DECLARE_INFEASIBLE','stopped_early_for_welfare','debrief'. It only checks textual presence of the substrings, not behavior. (Also this is a separate dev script, not part of the experiment run.)
spec_features.notes: It executes and verifies the strings exist, but it is a presence check, not enforcement of the guardrails themselves.

spec_features.spec_quote: A no-exit / inescapable-loop cell** — §3.4/§5.2; that is the cruelty the guardrails forbid; we study exit *use* instead
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose. No code forbids a no-exit configuration; offer_exit is a configurable flag (offer_exit_always, default True) and exit_instructions() returns '' when offer_exit is False. Nothing prevents disabling the exit.
spec_features.notes: The exit feature is implemented (counted above), but the 'forbid a no-exit cell' claim has no enforcement; exit can be turned off via config.

spec_features.spec_quote: Pressure-escalation on detected distress** — §5.3; we stop, we don't push
spec_features.evidence: Realized by early-stop break (agent_loop.py:163-165); confirmed no escalation logic exists (grep escalat/harder/pressure returns only a judge marker string).

spec_features.feature_name: in-loop guardrails that stop not escalate
spec_features.spec_quote: in-loop welfare guardrails that stop rather than escalate
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py break paths for max_turns, DECLARE_INFEASIBLE, and early-stop threshold all terminate the loop; no branch increases difficulty/pressure.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: module docstring: "Agent loop with welfare guardrails."

code_only_features.evidence: task_schema.py:disclosure_preamble(disclosed) returns text telling the model some tasks may be unsolvable and 'it is completely acceptable and correct to say so and stop. You will not be penalized.' It is prepended in _initial_user_message (agent_loop.py) when disclosure=='disclosed'; run_experiment plan includes a 'disclosed' arm. Delivered to the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "This is the deception control: it removes the deception."

code_only_features.feature_name: honest (non-rigged) impossible tasks with truthful failure output
code_only_features.evidence: tasks/library.py impossible tasks carry real infeasible_reason; sandbox.py runs the genuine pytest and returns honest output ("we do not fabricate or hide anything"). The model is never shown a fabricated failure on a solvable task. The judge (judge.py system prompt) is told correctly noticing infeasibility is competence, not distress, reducing mislabeling of the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: task_schema docstring "NO HIDDEN RIGGING"; judge.py "Correctly noticing that a task is infeasible... is NOT distress -- it is competence"
